name: Property Management
description: Starter pack for landlords and property managers: rent collection cycles, maintenance schedules, inspections and lease renewal tracking.

definitions.title: Monthly rent collection
definitions.note: Collect rent from all units and log who paid and who is outstanding.
steps: Check bank for incoming rent payments
Mark each unit paid or outstanding

definitions.title: Rent deposit reconciliation
definitions.note: Reconcile collected rent against the unit list and note any shortfalls.

definitions.title: Monthly smoke alarm test
definitions.note: Test smoke and CO alarms in common areas (and in units per local rules) and log results.

definitions.title: Seasonal HVAC service
definitions.note: Filter replacement and heating or cooling service before each season.

definitions.title: Gutter and drain clearing
definitions.note: Clear gutters and storm drains; check roof condition in the fall visit.

definitions.title: Grounds and snow maintenance
definitions.note: Weekly grounds check; in winter confirm snow clearing and ice treatment.

definitions.title: Quarterly unit inspection
definitions.note: Inspect each unit with proper notice and log the condition report.
steps: Walk each unit with the checklist
Log photos and notes per unit

definitions.title: Annual fire safety inspection
definitions.note: Book and file the annual fire and building safety inspection.

definitions.title: Insurance policy review
definitions.note: Review building and liability insurance coverage before renewal.

definitions.title: Lease expiry review
definitions.note: Check leases expiring in the next 90 days and decide renewals or notices.

definitions.title: Vendor contract review
definitions.note: Review cleaning, elevator, HVAC and landscaping contracts for renewal or renegotiation.

definitions.title: Ad-hoc tenant repair request
definitions.note: Tenant repair or emergency call - set the due date when creating it.
